header.name: Ores Dimension
header.description:
Ten new dimensions, one for every ore. The whole world is made of that ore - ore blocks, deepslate ore, blocks of the ore, and trees grown from it. Every mob there is the same mob you know, made of the ore, and drops it when killed.
Build a nether portal shape out of any blocks, then right click the frame holding an ore - a diamond, an iron ingot, redstone. The frame turns into that ore block by block and the portal opens. Turn on the Beta APIs experiment.
